# Vendored Apache Ossie schema

`ossie-0.2.0.dev0-schema.json` is a pinned copy of the official Apache Ossie
machine-readable schema from:

`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apache/ossie/main/core-spec/osi-schema.json`

The semantic compiler rejects a model version that differs from this pinned
schema. Upgrade the schema and semantic model together, then run the full test
suite.
